terms.definition: After context compaction, resume, fork, handoff, or a comparable boundary, verify bounded continuity evidence against current repository and authorization state before state-changing work; a packet or compacted summary is evidence, never authority.
terms.scope: context compaction, task resume, session recovery, assistant handoff, and primary/subagent convergence
non_meanings: authorization carried forward by a summary
a requirement to reload the complete framework or project corpus
